page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Two small reference marks stand in the right margin beside the lines "Alexā" and "Hadriani". Running head at top, page number at top right. A catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: est, molestatus fuit: & in itinere uersus Constanti-am ex rheda sua cecidit. Ignominiose depositus ili-[?]lic erat: declaratumq; fuit generale concilium habere potestatem in Papam. Vnde eius atq; Pauli secundi tempore res Pontificia ad magnam inclinationem uenit: semperq; in peius ruit. Sub Alexā drisexti regimine, Angelus supremus ex Hadriani mole in Tiberim cecidit, terrifico deiectus[?] fulmine. Quæ à Julio secundo, qui D. Petri clauem in Tibe-rim proiecit, infortunia hucusq; succreuerint, vix ulli sunt qui ignorant. Juxta D. Pauli prophetiam, impium illum Antichristum Christus conficiet spi-ritu oris sui, aduentusq; sui claritate delebit. Vi-vus mittetur (inquit Angelus ad Joannem) in stag-num ardentis ignis ac sulphuris, Apoc. 19. ubi cru-cietur in sempiternum. Fiat, fiat: Amen.
main_text.head: 162, JULIUS secundus.
main_text.p: Julius secundus, patria Genuensis, Sixti quarti Ro-mani olim pontificis, nepos (si non filius) & Julia-nus Ruerius antea nuncupatus, ex presbytero Cardinale, titulo S. Petri ad vincula, in magnum Dei adversarium, Papam, assumebatur. page.notes: Two small reference marks in the right margin (beside the lines with "Alexā" and "Hadriani") carry no text; they are not transcribed as notes. Doubtful readings: "ili-[?]lic" (hyphenated word at line end, the hyphen is printed but the first letters are uncertain); "deiectus[?]" (the printed form looks like "deieclus"); "drisexti" (the long s here may read as f; written with plain s). "Car-dinale" was printed without a visible hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. The running head "ACTIS LIBER VII" is given without the page number. The catchword "riati" stands at the foot right.
